name: hopr-tokens
title: HOPR tokens on Gnosis
description: Transfer activity for xHOPR and wxHOPR from indexed Gnosis logs.

queries.title: HOPR token transfers
queries.description: Fragment: ERC-20 Transfer events from the two Gnosis token contracts.
queries.sql:
-- The Transfer signature and deployed Gnosis addresses are constrained together
-- to use the (address, substring(topics from 1 for 32), block_number) index.
-- Only indexed, non-removed events are available; this is not a balance snapshot.
SELECT
  CASE address WHEN '\xd057604a14982fe8d88c5fc25aac3267ea142a08'::bytea THEN 'xHOPR' ELSE 'wxHOPR' END AS token,
  block_number AS block, tx_index, log_index, transaction_hash,
  substring(topics from 45 for 20) AS sender,
  substring(topics from 77 for 20) AS recipient,
  (SELECT sum(get_byte(data, i)::numeric * power(256::numeric, 31 - i)) FROM generate_series(0, 31) AS i) / 1000000000000000000::numeric AS amount
FROM log
WHERE address IN ('\xd057604a14982fe8d88c5fc25aac3267ea142a08'::bytea, '\xd4fdec44db9d44b8f2b6d529620f9c0c7066a2c1'::bytea)
  AND substring(topics from 1 for 32) = '\xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef'::bytea
  AND NOT removed
  AND octet_length(topics) >= 96
  AND octet_length(data) >= 32

queries.title: HOPR token supply history
queries.description: Cumulative indexed mint amounts minus burn amounts per token and 100,000-block bin.
queries.sql:
-- Zero-address transfers represent issuance and destruction. This is the
-- cumulative indexed change from zero, not a verified totalSupply snapshot.
WITH changes AS (
  SELECT token, (block / 100000) * 100000 AS block_bin,
    sum(CASE WHEN sender = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex') THEN amount ELSE 0 END
      - CASE WHEN recipient = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS change
  FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
  WHERE sender = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex')
     OR recipient = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex')
  GROUP BY token, (block / 100000)
)
SELECT token, block_bin,
  sum(change) OVER (PARTITION BY token ORDER BY block_bin ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS supply
FROM changes
ORDER BY token, block_bin

queries.title: HOPR token activity
queries.description: Transfer counts and amounts by token and 100,000-block bin.
queries.sql:
SELECT token, (block / 100000) * 100000 AS block_bin, count(*) AS transfers, sum(amount) AS amount
FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
GROUP BY token, (block / 100000)
ORDER BY block_bin, token

queries.title: Recent HOPR token transfers
queries.description: The latest 500 indexed Transfer events, including mints and burns.
queries.sql:
SELECT token, block, '0x' || encode(sender, 'hex') AS sender, '0x' || encode(recipient, 'hex') AS recipient, amount, '0x' || encode(transaction_hash, 'hex') AS transaction
FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC
LIMIT 500

options.note: The charts reconstruct supply as indexed mints minus burns; they equal actual total supply only if every relevant Transfer event since deployment is indexed and no starting supply is missing. Coverage cannot be verified from these logs alone.
